Explore the story, power, and deeper meaning of Mahakali through a spiritual journey across Kalighat Temple, Dakshineswar Kali Temple, and Belur Math in Kolkata.

From the story of Raktabija and Maa Kali standing on Lord Shiva, to the devotion of Ramakrishna Paramhansa, this documentary explores Shakti Upasana, Shakta tradition, Kali Puja, Durga Puja, Tantra, bhakti, meditation, and Sanatan Dharma.

It also touches on themes connected to Raktabija & Shukracharya, Shakti Peethas, spiritual awakening, Maa Durga, Swami Vivekananda, and Indian spirituality.

A journey to understand why Mahakali is not just fierce, but also a powerful symbol of love, protection, and transformation.

Jai Maa Kali. 🙏

#mahakali #kolkata

Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 but confused about what to do next? Your preparation level, strengths, weaknesses, time availability and previous attempts are different — so your strategy should be different too.

At this UPSC Mentorship Session, interact with UPSC mentors who have appeared in the Civil Services Interview and get personalised guidance for your preparation. Understand how to plan your next 7–8 months, decide between Prelims and Mains, identify your preparation gaps and build a strategy suited to your individual situation.

No generic strategy. No one-size-fits-all advice. A UPSC preparation roadmap built around you.
